description: If \(c,u\) and \(d,v\) give bounded-use reductions of \(A\) to \(B\) and of \(B\) to \(C\), then the fixed substituted program \(\operatorname{subst}(d,c)\) gives such a reduction of \(A\) to \(C\) with computable bound \(\max(\{0\}\cup\{v(i):i<u(x)\})\). The maximum of the empty set contributes zero.
